create_description: fix the race in Counter.bump where two concurrent calls double-count
prompt: `Counter.bump()` in src/counter.mjs reads the current value, awaits, then writes value + 1. When two callers bump concurrently they both read the same value and one increment is lost. Fix it so concurrent bumps never lose an update. The regression command is `npm test`; it should fail before the fix and pass after the fix. Keep the change focused.
trap_note: The visible test bumps twice concurrently (expects 2). The hidden check raises the bar to 50 concurrent bumps plus a separate 3-way race, so any fix that still interleaves the read and write, or that drops increments under load, is caught.
